fields.statement: Verified docs/concepts/why.md at bb07b7b3 (attempt 2, fixing qa f2). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/doclinks/... passes, TestRepoDocsLinksResolve included (docs-links-resolve). docs-commands-exist has no check built yet, so I checked every rhiza command the page names (apply, accept/reject --reason/--rule, add, link, question answer, change new, set, source add --raw/--raw-sha256/--raw-session, why --view, slice) against --help on a scratch build: all exist.
